purpose: Read-only V6 status reporting policy. Reports may remind and summarize, but must not trigger orders.

daily: 检查 V6-A / V6-B 任务是否按预期运行。
检查是否出现订单、行情、账户或 OpenD 异常。
不要因为单日噪音修改策略层规则。
weekly: 复核 V6-A 理论目标仓位与实际 managed state 是否一致。
复核本周收益、最大回撤、最差单日和执行偏差。
复核 V6-B 前向观察数据是否干净。
决定继续、暂停，还是刷新 release gate。
monthly: 做一次动态候选池的漏网机会复盘。
如证据支持，刷新 V6-B point-in-time 候选池。
没有 standalone、V6-A 对比、allocator 和 replay 证据前，不提升 V6-B 权重。
quarterly: 运行 deterministic replay、release gate、黑天鹅窗口、滚动 3y/5y、鲁棒性和实盘可交易性检查。
复核 V6 Engine 参数和 Core Pool 候选池。
任何生产级修改都必须同步更新 V6_STRATEGY_LAB.md、AI Wiki 和 SYSTEM_OVERVIEW。

mainline_intelligence.purpose: Feed V6-B mainline_classifier. Automation should collect repeatable evidence; user review should focus on high-context items that are hard to scrape reliably.

daily_user_focus.ask: 补充今天新增或明显升温的主题、产业链扩散、关键催化、被反复提到的 ticker。
daily_user_focus.system_use: Narrative evidence: add candidate themes, update theme breadth notes, and explain why a theme may deserve starter-stage monitoring.

daily_user_focus.ask: 记录主线候选里的业绩上修、订单/capex、指引变化、分析师分歧明显的文章或财报线索。
daily_user_focus.system_use: Fundamental evidence: raise/lower theme quality and stock-pool priority; never trade from article sentiment alone.

daily_user_focus.ask: 季度窗口只复核高质量机构是否持续加仓同一主线及其核心表达，不做短线开关。
daily_user_focus.system_use: Institutional evidence: slow confirmation layer for theme persistence and stock-pool weighting.

automation_targets: Market evidence: 3/6/12m relative strength, theme ETF trend, breadth, drawdown and leadership versus SPY/QQQ.
Narrative evidence: X Radar theme mentions, new links in the value chain, repeated catalyst/ticker references.
Fundamental evidence: revisions, guidance, capex/order comments, earnings-driven theme confirmation.
Institutional evidence: 13F concentration and sustained high-quality holder accumulation, only as delayed confirmation.
mainline_intelligence.daily_output_rule: Daily email should state what automation can collect and what the user should manually triage today. No non-price source may directly trigger trades.

boundaries: 报告系统只读，不能下单。
邮件只是提醒，不能作为自动交易触发器。
V6-A 实盘 pilot 的下一阶段仍需要明确人工确认。
V6-B 在 point-in-time、OOS、replay、allocator 和可交易性证据通过前，只能研究/模拟。
Allocator 只有在证据充分后才调整资金权重；它是风控层，不是追涨层。

email.boundary: Email is read-only and must not trigger trading.
